skill.name: ai-avatar-video
skill.description: Create talking-head and AI avatar videos with inference.sh models through the belt CLI.
skill.summary: Generate avatar videos from portraits, scripts, or audio using hosted inference models.
skill.author: skills-shell

security_audit.summary: The skill legitimately invokes hosted inference models, so command blocks that run belt, redirect outputs, loop over jobs, or install packages are confirmed. Formatting-only backticks and placeholder or documentation URLs are false positives, while the remote image carries a minor privacy risk. The UGC workflow also encourages synthetic testimonials designed to appear authentic.

remediation.issue: Remote package installation can execute unreviewed package code.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval and pin reviewed package versions before running any npx installation command.

remediation.issue: Hosted belt jobs upload media, may write local output files, and may create usage charges.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm uploads, output paths, model choice, and estimated charges before executing belt workflows.

remediation.issue: The UGC examples present synthetic speakers as authentic customers.
remediation.suggestion: Require consent, synthetic-media disclosure, and truthful claims. Remove instructions that frame generated endorsements as real testimonials.

remediation.issue: The remote Markdown image can disclose viewer network metadata.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle a reviewed local image or omit the remote image from marketplace-rendered documentation.

content.user_title: Create AI Avatar and Talking-Head Videos
content.value_statement: Producing presenter videos requires coordinated portrait, speech, and lip-sync tools. This skill guides inference.sh model selection and belt CLI workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates talking-head videos from a portrait and script with P-Video-Avatar.
Creates audio-driven avatars with OmniHuman, Fabric, and PixVerse.
Controls voice, language, resolution, delivery style, and scene prompts where supported.
Combines portrait generation with avatar video generation.
Outlines transcription, translation, speech generation, and lip-sync workflows for dubbing.
Runs batch avatar jobs with multiple supported voices.
limitations: Requires the belt CLI, an inference.sh account, network access, and available service credits.
Uploads portrait, audio, or video inputs to hosted model services.
Model pricing, speed, voices, languages, and availability may change.
Users must secure consent, media rights, and required synthetic-content disclosures.

use_cases.title: Produce Course Presenters
use_cases.description: Turn approved instructor portraits and lesson scripts into consistent talking-head segments.

use_cases.title: Localize Existing Videos
use_cases.description: Transcribe, translate, synthesize speech, and lip-sync approved videos for another language.

use_cases.title: Create Character Dialogue
use_cases.description: Generate voiced avatar clips for original game characters and approved virtual presenters.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Avatar
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 720p talking-head video from my approved portrait. Use this script: [script]. Ask before running any paid command.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has one portrait and a short script.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Avatar Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare P-Video-Avatar, OmniHuman, Fabric, and PixVerse for [requirements]. Recommend one model and explain cost, speed, inputs, and limitations.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs help selecting a model.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Dubbing Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a consented dubbing workflow for [video] from [source language] to [target language]. Confirm each external job before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: A localization team needs transcription, speech, and lip-sync stages.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reviewed Batch Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a batch workflow for [number] approved presenters. Estimate jobs and costs, require disclosure, validate inputs, and pause before all external commands.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs controlled multi-presenter production.

output_examples.input: Create a product walkthrough from my approved portrait and 30-second script.
output: Recommended model: P-Video-Avatar with built-in speech.
Planned output: 720p talking-head video using the supplied portrait and script.
Approval needed before uploading media or starting the paid inference job.

output_examples.input: Which model should animate two people from one image?
output_examples.output: OmniHuman 1.5 is the documented multi-character option. Provide approved image and audio sources, then confirm before submitting the hosted job.

output_examples.input: Plan a Spanish dub for an existing training video.
output: Review the Spanish translation before speech generation.
Generate approved Spanish speech and lip-sync it to the original video.
Review timing, pronunciation, consent, and disclosure before distribution.

best_practices: Use front-facing, well-lit portraits and clean audio from consenting participants.
Estimate service costs and obtain approval before every hosted or batch job.
Review lip sync, pronunciation, factual claims, rights, and synthetic-media disclosures before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not imitate a real person without explicit authorization.
Do not present generated endorsements as genuine customer experiences.
Do not execute remote installers or paid inference jobs without informed approval.

faq.question: Which model supports scripts without separate audio?
faq.answer: P-Video-Avatar includes text-to-speech and accepts a portrait with a voice script.

faq.question: Which model supports multiple people?
faq.answer: The skill identifies OmniHuman 1.5 for multi-character, audio-driven animation.

faq.question: Can this skill dub an existing video?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines transcription, translation, speech generation, and LatentSync lip-sync stages.

faq.question: Does the skill work without network access?
faq.answer: No. The belt CLI calls hosted inference services and requires authentication.

faq.question: Will video generation create charges?
faq.answer: It may. Review current provider pricing and confirm estimated usage before starting each job.

faq.question: Can I use any portrait or voice?
faq.answer: Only use media you own or are authorized to process. Obtain consent and disclose synthetic output where required.
